The '''Art Manager''' is an NPC featured in the [[Somnium Labyrinth]] [[Event]] as part of the quest [[Dreamscape Odyssey: The Mountain and Six Credits]]. He serves as the antagonist in [[Zhezhi]]'s Somnoire storyline. During the quest, the Art Manager is portrayed as someone who exploits Zhezhi's artistic skills, using her talent to create fine art that he sells at auctions for the highest prices. He pressures Zhezhi to recreate another ''Winter's Serenade in Bloom'', which he believes would fetch a significant sum at auction. However, Zhezhi refuses his demand after meeting and gaining insight from [[Rover]] in the Somnoire.
